notes.title: Big update! Spider 1.1 now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Spider updated with gameplay improvements & bug fixes[/h1]

Hi y'all! This is the Spider: RotSM update you've been waiting for. Download and enjoy!  

[i]Got a friend foolish enough not to have tried Spider yet? Have them add it to their wishlist. We plan to put the game on sale soon![/i]

[*] Time Machine & Weather Device now work for an hour at a time before needing to be recharged. You're welcome!
[*] Final puzzle tracked correctly. Visit Blackbird Estate to get that pesky ? removed from your list!
[*] What's The Rush achievement now tracked more clearly.
[*] Playability improvements to certain insect behaviors.
[*] All moon phases appear correctly in all levels.
[*] Any stray leaderboard issues now fixed for all players.
[*] Invisible Jack-O-Lantern removed from the graveyard.
[*] Some misc bug fixes and playability improvements, just for fun.

Thanks to everyone who plays Spider and figured out it's a much deeper game than it seems on the surface.  Please tell your friends to try it!

notes.title: HALLOWEEN SALE UPDATE !!
notes.content:
[h1]Spider UPDATED and ON SALE for the first time![/h1]
Just in time for the annual Steam Halloween Sale, Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon is now updated and [b][u]on sale for the first time[/u][/b]!!   

You have [b]only until November 1st[/b] to get Spider for just $8.70.  That's 33% off!  Another sale is not coming along any time soon.

[b]What's in the update??[/b]  Feature requests and bug fixes that our players have asked for: 
[*] Weather Device & Time Machine now stay active for a full hour.
[*] Leaderboard fixes - Your fixed scores should submit automatically!
[*] Special HALLOWEEN SURPRISE - Can you find what we left for you in a special place?
[*] Moons flipped - We flipped 'em back to the way the moon should look.
[*] Final puzzle correctly marked solved, if/when you ever solve it. Have you!?
[*] Puzzles still no longer gate exploration, which along with the increased duration of the Weather Device & Time Machine, means Blackbird Estate in its many variations is all the more yours to explore.

If your high scores don't automatically update on the global leaderboard, just toggle "Submit Scores" off and then on again in the Settings menu.  This will trigger our fix.

notes.title: Wot I Think Spider: Rite Of The Shrouded Moon
notes.content:
No-one’s done Spider Simulator yet, although there’s almost certainly someone somewhere waiting to press publish on a perfunctory Greenlight page, but in its absence this genteel puzzle game about web-spinning and fly-paralysing might fit the bill. Spider: Rite Of The Shrouded Moon [official site], from a team lead by Ion Storm alumnus Randy Smith, does much more than that, even weaving a careful and subtle tale in the background and, er, spying on you.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Cutey Crawly Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon Is Out
notes.content:
Cobrastyle is, of course, that FIFA song (also covered excellently by Robyn), but what about Tiger Style? Well, that’ll be a video game studio, not a pop song. The last game from the gang founded by Looking Glass Thief chap Randy Smith and his Ion Storm pal David Kalina was Waking Mars, which found its way to PC, but before that they made mobile-only insect-gobbling puzzle-platformer Spider: The Secret of Bryce Manor.

The sequel to that, Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon [official site], launched on PC last week for your playing pleasure. I would’ve told you sooner but I’ve been moving flat and it’s hell.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon, 10% off!
notes.content:
Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

You are a spider. Craft webs of your own design to trap insects and leave the mysterious Blackbird Estate covered in cobwebs. This unique blend of action-puzzle gameplay takes you on a dark adventure through an abandoned mansion built by a secret society.

*Offer ends August 13 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: AUGUST 6: WELCOME TO BLACKBIRD ESTATE
notes.content:
[i]Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon[/i] is here in just 2 short days! 

This is Randy Smith, creative director of Tiger Style, creators of [i]Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon[/i] and prior to that 2012's epic sci-fi adventure [i]Waking Mars[/i]. 

Join the discussion to learn about Spider with all its deep insect-hunting, web-spinning gameplay, its layers upon layers of secrets and mysteries, and its magical, creepy quality of knowing where you are in the real world and matching the time and weather in the game with that outside your window.

You've never played a game quite like this before... Unless you're already playing it! In which case, come tell us what you think!
